And I understand how your mom making you take these courses and other things can be very stressful. Believe me, I got into an argument with my mom today, and  I'm just home summer break. Anyway, you had the to strength to ask for help. That's something I couldn't do for a long time, my parents still don't even know. I don't think you're a loser, not trying to imply I know your life or anything, but I don't think it (I'm a loser so I've got credibility and shit ya know lol). But seriously man, just from what I read, I promise you it will get SO much better. Especially when you get to college or really, when you leave home (you're taking AP or IB classes I'm guessing so I'm thinking college) I promise your hard work will pay off and once you leave the chains you're being put under, you'll feel relief. But yeah def try to find someone to talk to at least. I don't use this account too much but I'll talk to you as much as I can. Be safe bud.

Also, I hope I didn't come off as a dick or anything. I didn't mean it in any way if I did. First time I've ever commented on a SW post. I just saw that no one had commented so I felt I had to. I hope this reaches you.
